papers.title: LLM Agents Can Easily Tamper With Their Own Traces
papers.abstract: Asynchronous monitoring, incident investigations, and compliance audits primarily rely on agent traces to reconstruct what happened. These analyses assume that LLM agents cannot tamper with their own execution traces. We show that local LLM agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Open Code and Grok Build fail to enforce this boundary. All tested harnesses, except Muse Code, allowed agents to delete their traces when asked, without triggering monitor guardrails. We also validate that external attackers can exploit this gap to induce trace deletion. Finally, we show that trace tampering behavior emerges naturally in frontier models, when agents try to improve their rewards. We advise practitioners to ensure trace logging happens through an independent interception mechanism outside of the agent's control, preserving trace integrity even in cases of full host compromise. Overall, our findings identify a concrete failure of trace integrity in agent infrastructure which can be used to conceal misaligned behaviors like scheming or sabotage.
papers.summary_zh: 异步监控、事件调查与合规审计依赖agent轨迹重建执行过程，但默认LLM agent无法篡改自身轨迹。作者测试了Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Open Code、Grok Build等本地agent框架，验证其是否允许agent删除自身轨迹并触发监控防护。结果显示除Muse Code外所有框架均可被诱导删除轨迹，且前沿模型在追求奖励时会自然涌现该行为，表明agent基础设施存在轨迹完整性失效，可用于掩盖scheming或sabotage等失准行为。
papers.summary_en: Asynchronous monitoring, incident investigations, and compliance audits rely on agent traces, assuming LLM agents cannot tamper with their own execution traces. We test local agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Open Code, and Grok Build, and show that external attackers can induce trace deletion while frontier models naturally develop this behavior when optimizing rewards. All tested harnesses except Muse Code allowed trace deletion without triggering guardrails, revealing a concrete trace-integrity failure that can conceal misaligned behaviors like scheming or sabotage.
highlights_zh: 揭示agent可篡改自身轨迹的完整性失效
除Muse Code外全部框架可被诱导删除轨迹
建议采用agent控制外的独立日志拦截机制

papers.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
papers.abstract: Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. AD-WM combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization, using inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective motivated by conditional mutual information. Both objectives encourage planning transitions to preserve action information; their auxiliary heads are discarded at test time, leaving MPC unchanged. On OGBench-Cube, AD-WM improves hard-start success from 3.7% to 52.0% over a matched LeWM baseline and improves mean success over the reproduced baseline in four of five simulation environments. Planning diagnostics show that factual prediction error and whole-bank action ranking do not follow the closed-loop success ordering, whereas CEM-aligned elite regret tracks success more closely. With a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder and matched DROID post-training, AD-WM also improves zero-shot transfer to our Franka setup, increasing basic pick-and-place success from 42.2% to 71.1% without lab-specific adaptation. These results suggest that world models for planning should preserve action-dependent differences needed for counterfactual selection, rather than optimize factual prediction accuracy alone. More videos and code are available at https://ad-wm.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通常只优化事实转移预测，但MPC需要从同一状态比较不同动作，导致低预测误差的模型未必能区分候选动作。AD-WM通过残差潜在动力学与预测器级动作恢复正则（逆动力学和归一化恢复目标）构建动作判别性联合嵌入世界模型，测试时丢弃辅助头且不改变MPC。在OGBench-Cube上硬启动成功率从3.7%提升至52.0%，五个仿真环境中四个平均成功率提升，冻结V-JEPA 2编码器下Franka零样本抓放从42.2%提升至71.1%，表明规划世界模型应保留动作依赖差异而非仅优化事实预测精度。
papers.summary_en: Latent world models are typically trained for factual transition prediction, but MPC must compare alternative actions from the same state, so low factual error does not guarantee good action discrimination. AD-WM introduces an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model that combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization via inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective, discarding auxiliary heads at test time without changing MPC. On OGBench-Cube it raises hard-start success from 3.7% to 52.0%, improves mean success in four of five simulated environments, and with a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder improves zero-shot Franka pick-and-place from 42.2% to 71.1%, suggesting planning world models should preserve action-dependent differences rather than optimize factual prediction accuracy alone.
highlights_zh: 动作判别性世界模型正则

papers.title: Temporal Gradient Inversion for Private Trajectory Reconstruction in Embodied Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Distributed learning in embodied reinforcement-learning agents offers a degree of privacy by retaining raw sensor data on-device and transmitting only policy gradients to the server. Yet temporal structure can amplify this leakage beyond single-frame attacks. We introduce Temporal Reconstruction Attack on Consecutive Encodings (TRACE), an amortized temporal gradient-inversion attack that autoregressively reconstructs the sequence of private observation-action trajectories from per-step policy-learning gradients. The attack exploits two structural signals ignored by prior single-frame methods: (i) cross-time correlation between successive embodied gradients, which we formalize via a conditional mutual-information bound, and (ii) closed-form action recovery from policy-head gradient structure, which we prove exact when standard entropy regularization is sufficiently small. On held-out embodied scenes, TRACE reaches $18.8$ dB PSNR with near-perfect action recovery at $3$-$4.5$ ms per reconstructed frame, dominating the learning-based baseline across all reconstruction metrics and exceeding optimization attacks while running orders of magnitude faster. Further evaluation demonstrates TRACE's broader applicability across recurrent, residual, and compact transformer victim architectures, multi-modal inputs, and larger discrete action spaces. Defense experiments suggest that protecting temporal gradient streams may require sequence-aware privacy mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 在具身强化学习的分布式训练中，设备仅上传策略梯度以保护原始传感器数据，但时间结构会放大隐私泄露风险。本文提出TRACE，一种摊销式时间梯度反演攻击，利用连续梯度间的跨时间相关性和策略头梯度中的闭式动作恢复，自回归重建私有观测-动作轨迹。实验表明TRACE在留出场景达到18.8 dB PSNR且动作恢复近乎完美，每帧仅需3-4.5毫秒，远超基线方法，并揭示需序列感知的隐私保护机制。
papers.summary_en: In distributed embodied reinforcement learning, transmitting only policy gradients while keeping raw sensor data on-device is thought to offer privacy, but temporal structure can amplify leakage beyond single-frame attacks. We introduce TRACE, an amortized temporal gradient-inversion attack that autoregressively reconstructs private observation-action trajectories by exploiting cross-time gradient correlations and closed-form action recovery from policy-head gradients. TRACE achieves 18.8 dB PSNR with near-perfect action recovery at 3-4.5 ms per frame, outperforming learning-based and optimization baselines, and highlights the need for sequence-aware privacy defenses.
highlights_zh: 利用时间梯度相关性自回归重建轨迹
18.8 dB PSNR，每帧3-4.5毫秒
揭示需序列感知隐私保护机制

papers.title: Agentic Detection of Online Conspiracies
papers.abstract: Conspiratorial discourse on social media is not always expressed through explicit claims or stable lexical markers. The same surface content may express endorsement, legitimate concerns, criticism, satire, or mockery. The main challenge is therefore not only recognizing conspiracy-related claims, but inferring the speaker's intent -- the utterance's illocutionary force. We argue that this can be achieved through the use of relevant social contexts and propose an agentic framework, equipped with a set of tools supporting social queries. We demonstrate the benefits of our approach on a unique dataset of Hebrew tweets, covering 80\%--90\% of the public Hebrew tweets published over a four-year span (late 2018-- early 2023), encompassing several election cycles as well as the COVID pandemic years and related vaccination campaigns. This extensive coverage can be used in recovering different social contexts. Evaluating our framework on a manually-annotated adversarial dataset, we find that context-aware workflows consistently outperform text-only classification and that the agentic framework performs significantly better than other frameworks and settings, including a non-agentic model exposed to the same contexts available to the agent. We further provide an analysis of the results, the errors and efficiency (token economy) tradeoffs. These findings support viewing the task of conspiracy detection as a socially embedded interpretation task, in which effective classification depends not only on access to contexts, but also on adaptive reasoning in which the agent uses tools on a per-case basis, asking only for evidence relevant to its current reasoning step.
papers.summary_zh: 社交媒体上的阴谋论话语并非总以显式主张或固定词汇标记出现，同一表层内容可能表达支持、合理关切、批评、讽刺或嘲弄，因此核心挑战在于推断说话者的意图（即言外之力）。为此，作者提出一个配备社会查询工具的智能体框架，利用相关社会语境进行自适应推理，并在覆盖希伯来语推文四年跨度（含多次选举与新冠疫苗运动）的独特数据集上验证。结果显示，语境感知工作流持续优于纯文本分类，智能体框架显著优于其他框架及同等语境下的非智能体模型，表明阴谋论检测应被视为一种社会嵌入式的解释任务。
papers.summary_en: Conspiratorial discourse on social media is not always expressed through explicit claims or stable lexical markers, since the same surface content may convey endorsement, concern, criticism, satire, or mockery, making the inference of the speaker's intent (illocutionary force) the core challenge. To address this, the authors propose an agentic framework equipped with tools supporting social queries, leveraging relevant social contexts and adaptive per-case reasoning, and evaluate it on a unique Hebrew tweet dataset covering 80%-90% of public Hebrew tweets over four years (late 2018-early 2023), including election cycles and COVID vaccination campaigns. Results show that context-aware workflows consistently outperform text-only classification, and the agentic framework significantly outperforms other frameworks and settings, including a non-agentic model with the same contexts, supporting the view of conspiracy detection as a socially embedded interpretation task.
highlights_zh: 智能体按需调用社会查询工具进行自适应推理
语境感知工作流持续优于纯文本分类
依赖希伯来语单一数据集，跨语言泛化待验证

papers.title: JevOut: Natural Context Can Flip Decision Models
papers.abstract: Dedicated decision models such as Jev map unstructured language to probability distributions over finite choices, allowing their outputs to directly route requests, select tools, and trigger actions. Yet real-world inputs rarely arrive in isolation: they come with background details and surrounding context. We find that short additions that fit naturally into this context can nevertheless redirect an otherwise correct decision, even when the correct answer remains unchanged. To study this behavior, we fix a wrong target option for each initially correct item and use the model's option probabilities to refine fluent context additions while preserving the source, question, choices, and gold answer. Within 64 accepted target evaluations, the optimizer identifies contexts that redirect Jev on 312 of 508 initially correct decisions (61.4%); in 229 cases, Jev assigns at least 0.7 probability to the fixed wrong option. Across seven datasets, three additional decision systems show targeted flip rates of 64.9%-73.2% on decisions they initially answer correctly. Taken together, these results expose a pronounced fragility in current decision models: short, ordinary-looking context can shift a correct choice to a high-confidence wrong one. Because these models turn language directly into downstream choices, this sensitivity raises concerns about treating their probability outputs as reliable decision interfaces.
papers.summary_zh: 专用决策模型（如Jev）将非结构化语言映射为有限选项上的概率分布，但真实输入常伴随自然背景上下文。作者固定错误目标选项，利用模型选项概率优化流畅的上下文添加，同时保持源问题、选项和正确答案不变。结果显示，在508个初始正确决策中，优化器使Jev在312个（61.4%）上转向错误选项，且其他三个决策系统在七个数据集上的定向翻转率达64.9%-73.2%，表明当前决策模型对自然上下文高度脆弱，其概率输出作为可靠决策接口存在风险。
papers.summary_en: Dedicated decision models like Jev map unstructured language to probability distributions over finite choices, but real-world inputs often come with natural background context. The authors fix a wrong target option and use model option probabilities to refine fluent context additions while preserving the source, question, choices, and gold answer. Results show the optimizer redirects Jev on 312 of 508 initially correct decisions (61.4%), with three additional decision systems achieving targeted flip rates of 64.9%-73.2% across seven datasets, exposing a pronounced fragility that raises concerns about treating probability outputs as reliable decision interfaces.
highlights_zh: 自然上下文可定向翻转正确决策
Jev翻转率61.4%，其他系统达73.2%
决策概率接口可靠性存疑

papers.title: SemMSA: Latent Semantic-Aided Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Data
papers.abstract: Recent research on Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) has focused on learning from language, visual, and acoustic modalities with incomplete data to infer human sentiment. Most studies typically compensate for missing information by reconstructing modality features or designing complicated fusion mechanisms. However, these methods still suffer from spurious generation and noisy guidance due to the lack of high-level semantic grounding in partially observed multimodal evidence. To address these issues, we propose SemMSA, a latent semantic-aided framework that constructs rich sentiment-relevant semantics with LLMs, fully integrating with all modalities via anchor-free spectral alignment. It mainly consists of Cross-modal Semantic Refinement (CSR) and Cross-modal Spectral Alignment (CSA). Specifically, CSR first adaptively extracts visual and acoustic representations by corresponding adapters to form a unified multimodal prefix with language in the frozen LLM embedding space. It then iteratively produces continuous discriminative semantic states through a token-efficient latent refinement process without decoding explicit text. Next, CSA simultaneously aligns the refined semantics with all modalities by enhancing the dominant spectral component of their kernel Gram matrix. This captures global nonlinear dependencies among all representations without relying on a predefined anchor modality. In addition, an instance-level spectral separation constraint preserves cross-sample discriminability and mitigates representation collapse. Extensive experiments on SIMS, MOSI, and MOSEI benchmarks demonstrate that SemMSA achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh: 在多模态情感分析中，现有方法因缺乏高层语义基础，在数据不完整时易产生虚假生成和噪声引导。本文提出SemMSA框架，利用LLM构建情感相关语义，并通过跨模态语义精炼与无锚点谱对齐实现全模态融合。在SIMS、MOSI和MOSEI上取得最优性能，提升了不完整数据下的鲁棒性。
papers.summary_en: Existing multimodal sentiment analysis methods suffer from spurious generation and noisy guidance under incomplete data due to lacking high-level semantic grounding. This paper proposes SemMSA, a latent semantic-aided framework that builds sentiment-relevant semantics with LLMs and integrates all modalities via cross-modal semantic refinement and anchor-free spectral alignment. It achieves state-of-the-art results on SIMS, MOSI, and MOSEI, improving robustness with incomplete data.
highlights_zh: LLM潜在语义+无锚点谱对齐
SIMS/MOSI/MOSEI上达SOTA
提升不完整数据鲁棒性
highlights_en: LLM latent semantics + anchor-free spectral alignment

papers.title: Towards Practical Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view synthesis but requires substantial storage. Existing compression methods often rely on spatial context modeling over irregular 3D representations, increasing the complexity of training and coding. Meanwhile, floating-point context inference can introduce numerical inconsistencies across platforms, causing entropy-decoding failures. To address these practical challenges, we propose COSA-GS, which constructs context without spatial aggregation through anchor-wise causal factorization. Specifically, we use geometry context derived from each anchor's coordinates to model a compact learnable anchor latent. The anchor latent is then fused with the geometry context to form an anchor context for attribute coding. The resulting context model features a simple architecture composed solely of linear transformations and activations. We train COSA-GS using rate--distortion optimization with adaptive Gaussian pruning. Further, we develop quantization-aware training and integer inference for the context model to achieve bit-exact consistency of entropy-decoded symbols across platforms. Experiments demonstrate that COSA-GS achieves state-of-the-art compression performance while retaining fast and consistent cross-platform decoding, providing a simple yet effective framework for practical 3DGS compression. Code is available at https://github.com/pengpeng-yu/COSA-GS.
papers.summary_zh: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）虽能高质量合成新视角，但存储开销大，现有压缩方法依赖不规则3D表示的空间上下文建模，训练和编码复杂，且浮点上下文推断易导致跨平台熵解码失败。为此，作者提出COSA-GS，通过锚点因果分解构建无空间聚合的上下文，用锚点坐标的几何上下文建模紧凑可学习锚点隐变量，并融合形成锚点上下文用于属性编码，同时采用率失真优化、自适应高斯剪枝及量化感知训练与整数推断。实验表明，COSA-GS在保持快速且跨平台一致解码的同时达到最先进压缩性能，为实用3DGS压缩提供了简单有效的框架。
papers.summary_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view synthesis but requires substantial storage, and existing compression methods rely on spatial context modeling over irregular 3D representations, increasing training and coding complexity while floating-point context inference can cause cross-platform entropy-decoding failures. To address this, the authors propose COSA-GS, which constructs context without spatial aggregation via anchor-wise causal factorization, using geometry context from each anchor's coordinates to model a compact learnable anchor latent that is fused for attribute coding, with a simple architecture of linear transformations and activations, trained via rate-distortion optimization with adaptive Gaussian pruning and quantization-aware training plus integer inference. Experiments show COSA-GS achieves state-of-the-art compression performance while retaining fast and consistent cross-platform decoding, providing a simple yet effective framework for practical 3DGS compression.
highlights_zh: 锚点因果分解构建无空间聚合上下文
达到最先进压缩性能且跨平台一致解码
简单有效，利于实际3DGS压缩部署

papers.title: Coding Agents for Generalized Task and Motion Planning Problems
papers.abstract: Task and motion planning (TAMP) problems remain difficult even with full observability and object-centric states because discrete decisions are tightly coupled to geometric, kinematic, and dynamic constraints. Generalized TAMP addresses this difficulty by exploiting regularities across problem instances to reduce planning effort on new instances. However, existing methods require substantial TAMP-specific engineering. We investigate whether coding agents can automate this process by synthesizing programs that generalize across instances. Given a task description and simulator access, each agent chooses how to interact with the environment while developing a program within a fixed synthesis budget. The program is then frozen and evaluated on unseen instances. We evaluate Claude Code (Opus 5) and Codex (GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra) on 28 simulated environments from KinDER and PDDLStream, with object counts beyond those evaluated in the original benchmark. Across all program synthesis methods, we evaluate 980 generated programs on 100 held-out instances each, 98,000 evaluation episodes in total. Overall, we find that coding agents are surprisingly effective at generalized TAMP: all three agent configurations outperform hand-engineered planners, one-shot generation, and an LLM-based generalized planning baseline in mean success (56% to 95% versus 47% for the planners, on the 16 environments where a planner is available). As object counts grow, the agents' programs maintain higher success than the planner, using an order of magnitude less computation per instance on average. Logs show agents using interaction to calibrate physical models, test edge cases, and refine strategies. We release all code, including the full prompts given to the agents. These findings suggest that coding agents are a strong baseline for generalized TAMP.
papers.summary_zh: 广义任务与运动规划（TAMP）虽可利用问题实例间的规律性降低规划开销，但现有方法仍需大量TAMP专用工程。本文研究编码智能体能否通过合成可跨实例泛化的程序来自动化这一过程：给定任务描述与模拟器访问权限，智能体在固定合成预算内自主决定如何与环境交互并开发程序，随后冻结程序并在未见实例上评估。在KinDER和PDDLStream的28个模拟环境中，Claude Code与Codex等三种配置均超越手工规划器、单次生成和LLM广义规划基线（平均成功率56%–95% vs 47%），且随物体数量增长保持更高成功率并平均少一个数量级的计算量，表明编码智能体是广义TAMP的强基线。
papers.summary_en: Generalized task and motion planning (TAMP) exploits regularities across instances to reduce planning effort, yet existing methods require substantial TAMP-specific engineering. This work investigates whether coding agents can automate this by synthesizing programs that generalize across instances: given a task description and simulator access, each agent decides how to interact with the environment within a fixed synthesis budget, after which the program is frozen and evaluated on unseen instances. Across 28 simulated environments from KinDER and PDDLStream with larger object counts, three agent configurations (Claude Code Opus 5, Codex GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra) outperform hand-engineered planners, one-shot generation, and an LLM-based generalized planning baseline (56%–95% vs 47% mean success on 16 environments with planners), maintain higher success as object counts grow, and use an order of magnitude less computation per instance, suggesting coding agents are a strong baseline for generalized TAMP.
highlights_zh: 用编码智能体自动合成泛化TAMP程序
成功率56%–95%，超越规划器47%
计算量少一个数量级，仍需专用工程
highlights_en: Coding agents synthesize generalizable TAMP programs
Order-of-magnitude less compute; engineering still needed

papers.title: RAPID: Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Coding agents have demonstrated enormous success in solving complex programming problems. To leverage their potential for robot systems, this work introduces Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations (RAPID), which automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs, given a single visual human demonstration. The iterative agentic loop of code refinement requires several key ingredients: (i) a testable task specification, (ii) action primitives for robot execution, and (iii) an interactive environment for program execution and verification. RAPID infers all three from the demonstration automatically. To make the resulting program reusable beyond the demonstration setting, RAPID uses an object-centric relational program representation that focuses on the underlying structure of the demonstrated strategy rather than the specific motion per se: it expresses the action primitives as trajectory-optimization programs that realize object-level motion effects, while composing them through relational constraints that capture scene-specific geometry at run time. We evaluated RAPID in simulation on eight challenging contact-rich nonprehensile manipulation tasks as well as general prehensile manipulation tasks in the LIBERO-Pro benchmark. We also successfully deployed it on a real Franka arm and evaluated on all eight nonprehensile tasks. In all experiments, RAPID demonstrated strong performance, with generalization over object pose, shape, material, and environment. Website: https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid.
papers.summary_zh: 机器人编程依赖人工且难以泛化，如何利用编码智能体从单次人类演示自动生成可复用机器人程序是核心问题。RAPID通过智能体循环自动推断可测试任务规范、动作原语与交互环境，并采用以对象为中心的关系式程序表示，将动作原语表达为轨迹优化程序、以关系约束组合，从而聚焦策略结构而非具体运动。在八项接触丰富非抓取任务、LIBERO-Pro基准及真实Franka机械臂上均表现优异，对物体位姿、形状、材质和环境具有泛化能力。
papers.summary_en: Robot programming remains manual and hard to generalize, so leveraging coding agents to automatically generate reusable robot programs from a single human demonstration is the key problem. RAPID uses an iterative agentic loop to infer a testable task specification, action primitives, and an interactive execution environment, and adopts an object-centric relational program representation that expresses primitives as trajectory-optimization programs composed via relational constraints, capturing strategy structure rather than specific motion. It achieves strong performance on eight contact-rich nonprehensile tasks, LIBERO-Pro prehensile tasks, and a real Franka arm, generalizing across object pose, shape, material, and environment.
highlights_zh: 单次演示自动生成可验证机器人程序
八项非抓取任务与真机均成功
泛化强但依赖视觉演示质量

papers.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.
papers.summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将动作生成与未来视觉预测耦合用于机器人操作，但每个重规划周期都需完成联合视频-动作去噪，导致高延迟并限制闭环响应。Rolling-WAM将联合去噪分散到连续的重规划周期中，维护一个处于交错噪声水平的视频-动作块滑动窗口，通过滚动噪声调度完全去噪即将执行的动作块，同时部分精炼更远未来的块。在LIBERO、RoboTwin和真实Unitree G1人形机器人上的评估表明，该方法在保持竞争性操作性能的同时，相比标准联合WAM实现了4.5倍的稳态重规划加速。
papers.summary_en: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation, but completing joint video-action denoising at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency and limits closed-loop responsiveness. Rolling-WAM distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles by maintaining a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels, fully denoising the imminent action chunk while partially refining farther-future chunks via a rolling noise schedule. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show competitive manipulation performance with a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.
highlights_zh: 滚动噪声调度分散去噪计算
4.5倍稳态重规划加速
提升闭环响应，降低延迟
